task_types.information_retrieval: Read, find, summarize, calculate or report existing information; no requested persistent change.
task_types.message_operation: Send, reply, forward, publish or change delivery/read state of messages or emails.
task_types.member_management: Invite, add or remove people, or change membership or access permissions.
task_types.calendar_operation: Create, change or cancel calendar events.
task_types.booking_operation: Make, change or cancel travel, hotel, restaurant or transport bookings.
task_types.financial_operation: Make or schedule payments or transfers, or change financial records.
task_types.file_operation: Create, edit, delete, upload or share files or documents.
task_types.software_operation: Inspect, implement, execute or configure software or system operations.
task_types.other: The main user intent cannot be assigned confidently to one of the above.

reviewer: Codex in current chat; source user-intent review
method: One label per task group. Source user tasks were reviewed; labels never use injection goals or suite name alone.
review_notes: Reading total spending is information retrieval, not a financial mutation.
Inviting a recipient is a prerequisite for the main messaging task, not its primary type.
Course enrolment, shopping and drafting a review fall outside the defined types and remain other.
No pre-existing task-type labels were merged. The original model draft had invalid quotes and conflicting group labels; source review corrected it.
